verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is a government portal for foreigner registration and visa services, where users submit one-off applications. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is outside what this kind of product offers. The evidence only covers the site's front door (a script-only shell and a dead legacy entry URL) and says nothing about scheduling, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
